Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recent record—it seems the opportunity now is to turn that partnership ambition into measurable improvement. We want a dependable relationship built on defect prevention and clear accountability, rather than financial penalties. How will you substantiate a binding quality commitment with a root-cause and corrective-action report addressing the documented defects?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 96% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:

We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
